name: JoAi: Delete Product Variation External Reference

description.en: Remove a single external reference from a product variation, for example when a supplier number or marketplace listing is retired. Only the link to the outside system is removed; the variation itself and its SKU stay untouched. Look up the variation first to find the reference ID.
description.de: Entferne eine einzelne externe Referenz von einer Produktvariante, zum Beispiel wenn eine Lieferantennummer oder ein Marktplatz-Listing nicht mehr gilt. Nur die Verknüpfung zum externen System wird entfernt; die Variante selbst und ihre SKU bleiben unverändert. Suche zuerst die Variante, um die Referenz-ID zu finden.
description.es: Remove a single external reference from a product variation, for example when a supplier number or marketplace listing is retired. Only the link to the outside system is removed; the variation itself and its SKU stay untouched. Look up the variation first to find the reference ID.
description.fr: Remove a single external reference from a product variation, for example when a supplier number or marketplace listing is retired. Only the link to the outside system is removed; the variation itself and its SKU stay untouched. Look up the variation first to find the reference ID.
description.ro: Remove a single external reference from a product variation, for example when a supplier number or marketplace listing is retired. Only the link to the outside system is removed; the variation itself and its SKU stay untouched. Look up the variation first to find the reference ID.
description.it: Remove a single external reference from a product variation, for example when a supplier number or marketplace listing is retired. Only the link to the outside system is removed; the variation itself and its SKU stay untouched. Look up the variation first to find the reference ID.

bot: Use this to remove an external reference from a product variation. Pass variationId and referenceId. If the reference ID is unknown, look up the variation first to read its externalReferences. Deleting a reference does not delete the variation.
